newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan money supply growth within outlook, BOJ says.
newsitem.headline: Japan money supply growth within outlook, BOJ says.

text.p: Japan's money supply growth in April was within the forecast of the Bank of Japan (BOJ), a senior BOJ official told reporters on Friday.
The official said the April 1 increase in Japan's sales tax did not appear to be affecting Japan's money supply growth greatly.

The BOJ last month announced that Japan's broadly defined money supply average of M2 plus certificates of deposit (CDs) was likely to grow by about three percent year-on-year in the April-June quarter.
"April's growth was within our quarterly outlook of about three percent growth," the official said.
The BOJ said earlier on Friday that M2 plus CDs grew a preliminary 3.1 percent in April from a year earlier.
